<function name="SetWrap" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets whether text wrapping should be enabled or disabled on <page>Label</page> and <page>DLabel</page> panels.

Use <page>DLabel:SetAutoStretchVertical</page> to automatically correct vertical size; <page>Panel:SizeToContents</page> will not set the correct height.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="wrap" type="boolean">`True` to enable text wrapping, `false` otherwise.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates two labels in a panel and sets the text wrapping to false and true respectively.</description>
	<code>
-- Background panel
local BGPanel = vgui.Create( "DPanel" )
BGPanel:SetSize( 300, 130 )
BGPanel:Center()
BGPanel:SetBackgroundColor( color_black )
		
-- Label with no text wrapping
local lbl_nowrap = vgui.Create( "DLabel", BGPanel )
lbl_nowrap:SetPos( 10, 10 )
lbl_nowrap:SetSize( 280, 50 )		
lbl_nowrap:SetFont( "GModNotify" )
lbl_nowrap:SetText( "This is a label that has text wrapping disabled." )

lbl_nowrap:SetWrap( false )

-- Label with text wrapping
local lbl_wrap = vgui.Create( "DLabel", BGPanel )
lbl_wrap:SetPos( 10, 70 )
lbl_wrap:SetSize( 280, 50 )
lbl_wrap:SetFont( "GModNotify" )
lbl_wrap:SetText( "This is a label that has text wrapping enabled." )

lbl_wrap:SetWrap( true )
	</code>
	<output><image src="Panel_SetWrap_example1.png"/></output>
</example>
